method: Built-in imagegen, edited from five supplied project photographs
disclosure: AI portrait interpretations, not documentary project photographs
placement: Home slideshow only when viewport width is below 600px

records.prompt:
Use case: compositing — portrait reframing and generative canvas extension.
Asset type: mobile hero background for Trayaksh Architeqts, tall portrait approximately 9:19 (roughly 1080×2280), full-bleed photograph, not a webpage mockup.
Input image 1 is the edit target and the architectural reference. Use this specific room, not a generic luxury interior.
Primary request: produce a premium, photorealistic architectural editorial portrait composition based closely on the reference. Reframe from slightly farther back and extend the ceiling and foreground floor where needed, so the room's main features fit together in a vertical phone screen. Do not merely crop a narrow slice from the existing landscape image.
Composition: important furniture and architectural details belong within the central 75% of the width and the 18–62% vertical area; retain breathing space at the sides. The lower 30% should be coherent, quiet foreground floor suitable for HTML headline and buttons over it. Natural perspective, straight verticals, believable scale, a restrained 24–28mm interior photography viewpoint. No blank panels, letterboxing, collages, frames, typography or UI.
Lighting and finish: bright soft daylight, realistic warm indirect light, restrained luxurious editorial photography, detailed fabric and wood grain, balanced highlights, gentle authentic shadows; crisp and inviting, not overprocessed CGI, not heavy orange tint.
Invariants: retain the reference's recognizable design language, palette, main furniture types and relative arrangement. Extend coherently rather than adding unrelated rooms, furnishings or architectural features. No people, new decorative clutter, watermarks, signatures, readable text, logos or fabricated awards. This is an AI portrait interpretation inspired by the original photo, not a documentary replacement.
Specific room constraints: Thane: preserve the warm walnut slatted media wall, ivory marble-look TV panel, softly lit paneled ceiling, teal sofa and floral ivory armchairs, carved compact puja niche and pale marble floor. Recompose the main seating, TV wall and ring pendant together in the upper central portion. Clean editorial styling: omit loose children's toys and small personal photograph clutter, retain the actual architectural features and furniture character.
